title: The 4 layers of modern agentic memory
description: Agent memory is not one thing, it is four layers, and most people only ever build the first. Workspace files your agent reads and writes. A searchable knowledge base or graph for the long stuff. Transcript search that gives it near photographic recall of everything it has ever done. And background processes that clean it all up and reinject the right context on every restart. Full breakdown is in my Skool. Link in bio.
